title: TabKD: Tabular Knowledge Distillation through Interaction Diversity of Learned Feature Bins
abstract: arXiv:2603.15481v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Data-free knowledge distillation enables model compression without original training data, critical for privacy-sensitive tabular domains. However, existing methods does not perform well on tabular data because they do not explicitly address feature interactions, the fundamental way tabular models encode predictive knowledge. We identify interaction diversity, systematic coverage of feature combinations, as an essential requirement for effective tabular distillation. To operationalize this insight, we propose TabKD, which learns adaptive feature bins aligned with teacher decision boundaries, then generates synthetic queries that maximize pairwise interaction coverage. Across 4 benchmark datasets and 4 teacher architectures, TabKD achieves highest student-teacher agreement in 14 out of 16 configurations, outperforming 5 state-of-the-art baselines. translated_title: TabKD：通过学习特征分箱的交互多样性实现表格数据知识蒸馏
translated_abstract: 无数据知识蒸馏能够在没有原始训练数据的情况下实现模型压缩，这对于隐私敏感的表格数据领域至关重要。然而，现有方法在表格数据上表现不佳，因为它们没有显式地处理特征交互——而特征交互正是表格模型编码预测知识的基本方式。我们识别出交互多样性（即对特征组合的系统性覆盖）是有效表格蒸馏的必要条件。为将这一洞察付诸实践，我们提出了TabKD，该方法学习与教师模型决策边界对齐的自适应特征分箱，然后生成最大化成对交互覆盖的合成查询。在4个基准数据集和4种教师架构上，TabKD在16个配置中的14个实现了最高的师生模型一致性，超越了5个最先进的基线方法。我们进一步表明，交互覆盖与蒸馏质量强相关。
tldr: 提出TabKD方法，通过学习与教师决策边界对齐的自适应特征分箱并生成最大化特征交互覆盖的合成查询，解决了无数据知识蒸馏在表格数据上忽视特征交互的问题，在16个配置中的14个取得最优师生一致性，显著超越现有基线。
en_tdlr: TabKD advances data-free knowledge distillation for tabular data by learning adaptive feature bins aligned with teacher decision boundaries and generating synthetic queries that maximize feature interaction coverage, achieving the highest student-teacher agreement in 14 out of 16 configurations and outperforming 5 state-of-the-art baselines.
